text.tspan: Position within the assayed tile span (%)
Per protein: prediction / S/T fraction / disorder
A: Tiles above median disorder and S/T; restriction, not exact matching. C: 454 informative proteins, equally weighted; full includes composition, geometry and
covariates. D: Adding composition to covariates; minimum 3 sites, final gap 10. Cohorts vary by core gap; archived paired protein-bootstrap 95% CIs. Coral:
primary definition. E: Existing examples, normalized assayed spans. No model refitting.
